title: An increase in the omega-6/omega-3 fatty acid ratio increases the risk for obesity
funder: I have not received any source of funding for this article.
authorConflicts: The author declares no conflict of interest.
result: Narrative review. States that the omega-6/omega-3 ratio of Western diets has risen from 1:1 during evolution to 20:1 or higher, in parallel with the rise in overweight and obesity, and that a high ratio increases the risk of obesity; tabulates ratios of 15.00 for the current UK and northern Europe and 16.74 for the current US. Concludes that a balanced omega-6/omega-3 ratio is important for the prevention and management of obesity.
